sermon.title: Jesus Teaches Hidden Secrets — May 29, 2022
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Jesus revealed things hidden since the foundation of the world through parables. We are salt and light by good works; the law stands, its weightier matters are justice, mercy and faith; anger without cause brings judgment, so reconcile first and let God search your heart.
